capabilities: Match paragraphs using custom regex patterns
Add copy buttons to matched paragraphs automatically
extras: The README is a single bilingual sentence (English and Chinese) with no usage examples or configuration details; not reviewed by Obsidian staff per the manifest.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to add one-click copy buttons to arbitrary paragraphs selected by user-defined patterns.
summary: Regex-matching plugin that automatically adds copy buttons to paragraphs in a note that match user-defined patterns.
